bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
bid.reason: The tender is for an IS audit and ITGRC automation tool, and explicitly excludes AI, MLOps, and generative AI capabilities from the current scope, marking them only for future phases.

evidence.quote: Layer 4 AI: Supervised AI assistance, cross-audit insight, model hosting and inference inside the Bank, LLMOps and MLOps. Not in scope of this RFP. The tool shall be compatible with the future-phase implementation (Clause 2.9)

1.7 Outside the scope of this RFP. The items below belong to the future phase. They shall not be priced in this bid. The tool shall provide the interfaces in Clause 2.9 so that they can be added later... • Model hosting and inference, LLMOps and MLOps.

The objective is that the tool becomes the Bank's single system of record for IS audit and ITGRC work, and that the Bank runs its audits end to end on it: planning, scoping, evidence collection, fieldwork documentation, review, reporting, observation tracking to verified closure, risk register and committee reporting.

key_facts.scope_summary: Supply, implementation, and maintenance of an automated tool for IS audit and ITGRC, excluding AI/MLOps features which are reserved for future phases.
